responsibility: This is the main implementation file for GCC’s SPU target backend. It owns the SPU target hooks and machine-dependent code generation logic, including builtin type construction and builtin declaration/expansion support, immediate and constant classification, addressing and reload legality, calling convention and return-value handling, stack frame/prologue/epilogue generation, section and symbol handling, scheduler and pipeline cost hooks, vectorization cost hooks, atomic expansion support, and many other targetm overrides that connect generic GCC middle-end/RTL stages to concrete SPU behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C implementation for the SPU port: it contains target hook bodies, builtin support code, and backend algorithms that use definitions from spu.h, options from spu.opt, and patterns from spu.md. Unlike those same-stem files, it is not a declarative header, option table, or machine-description pattern file.
